pairs: What are some species of bears that are now extinct?

There are many species of bears that are extinct, but some of the most well-known are the cave bear (Ursus spelaeus), the giant short-faced bear (Arctodus simus), and the Irish elk (Megaloceros giganteus). In total, there are approximately 9 extinct bear species, including the Giant Panda (Ailuropoda melanoleuca) and the Japanese Wolf (Canis lupus hodophilax).
